patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Instantly and 6sense share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Comparison thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose Instantly only if your buying job matches “Cold-email outreach infrastructure — Growth from $47/mo; Hypergrowth $97; Light Speed $358” rather than 6sense's shape. Choose 6sense only if your buying job matches “Enterprise ABM and sales intelligence platform for predictive intent, account prioritizati” rather than Instantly's shape. Workflow advantage: Instantly leans sales-engagement; 6sense leans data-enrichment, lead-management. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Instantly and 6sense share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Instantly is Cold-email outreach infrastructure — Growth from $47/mo; Hypergrowth $97; Light Speed $358; bundles/credits add-ons; Enterprise custom.; 6sense is Enterprise ABM and sales intelligence platform for predictive intent, account prioritization, and revenue-team orchestration — custom-quote .
- Company-size focus: Instantly (micro, small-business, mid-market) vs 6sense (mid-market, enterprise).
- Workflow coverage skew: Instantly-leaning sales-engagement vs 6sense-leaning data-enrichment, lead-management.
- Researched limits: Instantly — Cold-email infra first — not an SI contact-database core; 6sense — Seat and module prices are not published — packaging is custom quote.

Limitations — Instantly: Cold-email infra first — not an SI contact-database core; Lead finder/credits are add-on depth vs dedicated SI databases; 6sense: Seat and module prices are not published — packaging is custom quote; Enterprise ABM / predictive stack carries material implementation and admin overhead.

Poor-fit cases: Instantly is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Cold-email infra first — not an SI contact-database core · 6sense is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Seat and module prices are not published — packaging is custom quote · Avoid Instantly if you actually need 6sense's motion (Enterprise ABM and sales intelligence platform for predictive intent, account pr)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
